theorem.statement_short: For exact rank three, a disjoint source cut with one full-rank 3D Gram and one rank-2 Gram is paid whenever the quadratic restriction to the rank-2 spectral plane has nonzero determinant; the bound is 12.1398343707551 [det(G_I) pdet(G_J) |det Lambda| |det(Lambda|_P)|]^(-1/5), and the density is continuous.
theorem.key_identity: (s1 s2)^2 |gamma| = det(G_I) pdet(G_J) |det Lambda|^2 |t^T Lambda^{-1} t| = det(G_I) pdet(G_J) |det Lambda| |det(Lambda|_P)|
theorem.balanced_corollary: If the two nonzero eigenvalues of G_J lie in [1/4,3/4], |det Lambda|>=1, and |t^T Lambda^{-1}t|>=1/64, then ||p_Q||_infinity<54.482.

partner_result_applied.application: Combined hub-Schur bound with new inverse-Rayleigh branch: under both packets, |A00|>=1/64 or |t^T Lambda^{-1}t|>=1/64 implies ||p_Q||_infinity<104.512. The partner stress family has exact inverse-Rayleigh null q=0 and arbitrarily small A00, yet its source-first theorem gives ||p_Q||_infinity<176.
